SETUP_SECRET.description: Installation and maintenance secret / 安装与维护凭据。Use your password manager to generate a unique random password of at least 32 characters, and save it. You will enter the same value in the Web installation wizard. This is separate from your mailbox password. / 用密码管理器生成并保存至少 32 字符的独立随机密码，稍后在网页安装向导输入相同值；它与邮箱登录密码不同。

db.description: Stores accounts, mail and application settings / 保存账号、邮件和应用设置。Keep this database when updating / 更新时保留此数据库。
